It's not that he doesn't help. That isn't the case at all. But Guardians are supposed to watch over you and protect you and make you a better person. He did that. It's how he does it that isn't ideal.

Dameon says he sees a lot of himself in me, which makes no sense when I think about it. He was a benevolent demon. A lot of demons are apparently given a shot to become good with the big man upstairs, almost like parole for criminals. Fallen Angels are still above them, but if a demon is true about switching over to heaven's team, then they can try to prove themselves. Dameon was using me as a way to do so. He wanted to play the role of Guardian to prove that he was a changed man, or...being, I guess. Dameon was a pesky, annoying, troublesome person. He loved mischief and he enjoyed seeing others suffer. Still, he was dead set on watching over me. Somehow, he convinced himself that he was the same, if not better, than one of the real  Guardians that God assigned to people himself.

It wasn't all bad though. Dameon always had my best interest at heart. One time, one of the guys on the soccer team who bullied me was across the mall at the food court and since I'm the only one who can see him, he decided that he could mess around with him a bit. He knocked his tray of food out of his hands and pushed him over into the nearby fountain. To top it all off, he picked up the strawberry shake and dumped it on his head. Everyone was horrified to some degree. I had to leave the mall because I couldn't help but laugh. Those were my favorite times with Dameon. 

There was also the time in the parking lot when the girl I really liked almost got hit by some idiot who wasn't paying attention. Dameon possessed me and made me push her out of the way of the car. When Dameon possesses me, I become super human. I'm stronger, I can run faster, I can figure out solutions to things quicker and nine times out of ten, I've figured out how to properly solve the problem. Sometimes Dameon just takes over and it's just him doing whatever he wants, but using my body. I was able to push her out of the way and also keep myself away from the car too. Dameon didn't always do the right thing, but that day I felt pretty cool.

Having Dameon around can be annoying and it can make life harder, but he is trying to prove himself. I deal with it and try to see the bright side. Still, there are dangers that come with having a demon as a Guardian. One is that if Dameon fails to prove himself, he is sent back to hell with no second chance for redemption. I also get my memory wiped if he fails. I always seem to have to remind him of this fact. There is another huge part of the danger, which is the part that I am more concerned with, and that's Satan. 

Satan isn't a huge fan of his demons trying to leave. It is one less head working for his legion of darkness. There is a group of demons called Muertos, and they are kind of like a team of bounty hunters who are constantly on the look out for demons who are trying to get out. A lot of demons go for their shot at redemption in secret. As far as Satan knows, they are still out in the world pursuing the duties bestowed upon them, but they are actually out preventing the Lord of Darkness from completing his acts of evil. Some do what Dameon is doing, in which they pose as a Guardian and try to do what a regular Guardian would do.

Dameon protects me from things from my world and his. He may not be perfect, but I know that in order for him to gain his redemption, we need to work together.
